_about: Every player-facing string, as the English msgid the code passes to tr()/tr_n(). Translations live in <locale>.json next to this file; tools/i18n.py turns them into the .po files Godot loads. 'max' is a width budget in Latin characters (CJK text should use about half).

strings.id:
Tilt your device to move around the map and head for the exit tile.
The gauge in the corner shows your tilt: dashed ring to walk, solid ring to run.
strings.note: Tutorial lesson 1, shown in the bottom bar (two lines, up to about 85 characters a line)

strings.id:
Stepping on this tile will reverse the controls.
Step on another and they go back to normal.
strings.note: Tutorial lesson 2

strings.id:
Stepping on this tile will make Map Man disappear.
Don't worry, after a few moves he will show up again.
strings.note: Tutorial lesson 3

strings.id:
Stepping on this tile will cause Map Man to get stuck.
Shake your device to free him and get moving again.
strings.note: Tutorial lesson 4

strings.id:
Watch out for bonus points,
although you may have to go out of your way to get them.
strings.note: Tutorial lesson 5

strings.id:
Also keep an eye out for extra lives,
but take care as they will take you
even more off course than bonus points.
strings.note: Tutorial lesson 6

strings.id: Be careful of the poison tiles: if you step on them you will lose a life.
strings.note: Tutorial lesson 7

strings.id:
These tiles crumble away once you step off them.
There is no going back, so plan the way ahead.
strings.note: Tutorial lesson 8

strings.id:
Spikes rise and fall on a beat, with a warning first.
Wait for them to drop, then cross before they rise again.
strings.note: Tutorial lesson 9

strings.id:
Ice sends you sliding until a plain tile or the edge stops you.
You can't steer on it, so line up before you set off.
strings.note: Tutorial lesson 9

strings.id: These tiles will give you extra time or cost you time. You will get bonus points for time left on the clock when you finish each level.
strings.note: Tutorial lesson 10

strings.id: These tiles cause other tiles to disappear and reappear. When the tiles are hidden you can still step on them so remember where they are.
strings.note: Tutorial lesson 11

strings.id: Every so often you'll come across a checkpoint. Each time you reach a checkpoint you can restart from there instead of going back to the beginning.
strings.note: Tutorial lesson 12

strings.id: Tap the screen during play to pause. Holding your device a new way? Tap the corner gauge to set that as the new centre.
strings.note: Tutorial lesson 13

strings.id: You're all set, head for the exit to start the game. Have fun!
strings.note: Tutorial lesson 14
